value.rationale: The first pentagonal circular ladder is a canonical 10-vertex cubic prism where the current 2026 paper explicitly leaves ordinary matching-complex homotopy open. A complete mixed-dimensional integral homotopy classification resolves the named motivating example, contrasting sharply with contractibility of its perfect matching subcomplex. The explicit acyclic reduction and primitive integer attaching matrix demonstrate how nontrivial H2 and H3 coexist, and provide a reproducible benchmark for the wider open circular-ladder direction; this is not a mere Euler-characteristic recomputation.
